preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cities N in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 1000000000 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each city's significance A[i] must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
The total number of cities across all test cases must not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either -1 indicating impossibility or a non-negative integer representing the minimum total length of roads.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any((A[i] & A[j] & L) == L for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N) for L in range(1, 1000000001)) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid roads can be constructed, the output must be -1; otherwise, a valid total length must be output.
